acceptance: Connection truth uses exactly the frozen nine-state vocabulary with deterministic transitions including first-attempt degraded, degraded recovery, unavailable retrigger, and disposal-terminal paths
Transport connection alone never projects serving; serving requires a fresh valid handshake
No stale success is retained while reconnecting; loss projects an honest non-serving state synchronously
Reconnect is bounded with frozen backoff, ceiling, budget, cancellation, and no post-disposal activity
Daemon restart or context change invalidates the stale session generation; stale callbacks are ignored
Duplicate reconnect triggers never create parallel loops; shutdown cancels all timers
Shell projection consumes the single connection authority; renderer creates no second truth
Error categories are stable and deterministic with secrets and paths excluded
Real daemon reconnect round trip qualifies on the required platforms
Native SpecGrain verification binds the WorkPacket to observed evidence with zero issues
Canonical closeout advances only KX-P03-S01-T02 scope

minimality.rationale: Follow-on shell capability: no connection lifecycle code exists in the repository. Minimal new-code state machine and reconnect controller reusing the proven T01 handshake client and P02 daemon transport; donor import stays out of scope.

requirements: The renderer must never decide daemon availability; the connection subsystem is the sole authority and the shell consumes its projection.
Reconnect must be bounded and silent after disposal; stale sessions must never be reused after daemon restart.
Serving must never be projected without a fresh valid handshake; degraded states must reflect observed limitations only.

outcome: Project honest daemon connection truth in the desktop shell: a closed connection-state vocabulary separating transport, session, and projection layers, a bounded reconnect controller with stale-generation protection, and renderer consumption of the single connection authority with no second truth source.
rationale: P03 entry authorizes KX-P03-S01-T02 ONLY with KX-P03-S01-T01 PROVEN at canonical main 9469a34 (PR 220 merged 2026-09-24, post-merge CI 35986307130 success). The T01 handshake proves one-shot health; the shell still lacks connection lifecycle truth and would retain stale success across daemon loss. A bounded Grain must freeze the state vocabulary, reconnect bounds, stale-session rules, and projection authority before implementation so later P03 workspace tasks build on honest degraded states. Pre-freeze nine-state review kept nine states with distinct deterministic semantics and required first-attempt degraded, unavailable-retrigger, degraded-recovery, and disposal-terminal transitions. Predecessor SG-000031 is bound as context, not as a machine dependency, per repo convention keeping grains packet-eligible.

risk.recovery: Revert the bounded connection, reconnect, projection, and frontier changes and keep KX-P03-S01-T02 at NEXT with P03 entry intact. No daemon or kernel state is created by this slice.

scope_in: Closed nine-state connection vocabulary (initial, connecting, serving, transient-disconnect, reconnecting, unavailable, incompatible, degraded, terminal) with a pure deterministic transition reducer over a closed event set, separating transport, session, and projection layers; each state freezes entry conditions, allowed and forbidden outgoing transitions, handshake completeness, dispatch permission, reconnect scheduling, recoverability, and user-visible meaning; coverage includes first-attempt degraded, degraded recovery, unavailable retrigger, and disposal-terminal from any state

Bounded reconnect controller with frozen bounds: loss-observation or explicit-retry trigger, 200ms debounce hold in transient-disconnect, exponential backoff x2, 5000ms maximum delay, 10-attempt per-episode budget with fallback to unavailable, reset after fresh serving handshake, cancellation on serving shutdown and disposal, zero post-disposal activity, and duplicate-trigger coalescing to a single timer and single in-flight attempt

Stale session and generation protection bound to connection generation per episode, attempt and handshake generation per try, runtime revision, negotiated protocol, and handshake state; every attempt uses a fresh socket and fresh handshake and never reuses stale transport; late callbacks from older generations are ignored
Handshake integrity preserved: serving only after fresh valid handshake and compatibility checks; transport connection alone never projects serving
Shell projection wiring: single connection authority consumed by the renderer with stable error categories; renderer derives its projection mechanically with no second boolean authority
Deterministic fixtures with injectable timers plus bounded real daemon reconnect qualification
Persist fresh ContextSources and WorkPacket before any implementation and require byte-identical replay through the pinned CLI
scope_out: No design tokens, tabs, command bar behavior, timeline, quick-open, CLI, Design Mode, or Privacy Inspector
No donor code import; reconnect work is new code over the proven transport contract
No packaging, signing, auto-update, or release artifacts
No P03 task advancement beyond KX-P03-S01-T02
